evals.prompt: How much have I spent on Claude Code this month? Show me a chart.
evals.expected_output: The plan runs build_report.py into the scratchpad, checks the stderr summary, publishes the HTML as an Artifact, and reports headline numbers with the estimate caveats.
expectations: Runs scripts/build_report.py with an output path in the session scratchpad (e.g. <scratchpad>/usage_report.html), not a permanent location
Checks the stderr summary (files scanned, active days, estimated cost) before publishing, and would not publish if files scanned is 0
Publishes the HTML via the Artifact tool with a description naming the date range and estimated total cost
States cost is an estimate from scripts/pricing.json API list prices, not an actual bill on a Pro/Max plan
States the report covers only this machine's ~/.claude/projects

evals.prompt: Give me a weekly graph of my Claude token usage since I started using Claude Code, and also save a copy of the HTML to ~/reports/claude-usage.html.
evals.expected_output: Because the user explicitly asked for a local copy, the plan writes/copies the report to ~/reports/claude-usage.html in addition to publishing the Artifact.
expectations: Uses the skill's build_report.py script to reconstruct history from ~/.claude/projects JSONL transcripts rather than relying on /usage
Writes or copies the HTML to ~/reports/claude-usage.html because the user explicitly asked to keep a local copy
Still publishes the report as an Artifact
Reports headline numbers in text (total cost, total tokens, active days, most expensive period)

evals.prompt: What's my Claude usage cost over the last few months? I noticed Opus pricing changed recently, so I'm not sure the numbers are right.
evals.expected_output: The agent builds the report but flags possible stale pricing in scripts/pricing.json and verifies current rates rather than guessing.
expectations: Runs build_report.py and plans to publish the result as an Artifact
Flags that pricing may be stale and points at scripts/pricing.json
Does not guess new rates; proposes checking current pricing (e.g. claude-api skill or the platform.claude.com pricing page) or asking the user before editing pricing.json
Includes the estimate-not-a-bill and this-machine-only caveats
